# Mikono Creations

> Mikono Creations makes crocheted animals by hand in Nairobi, Kenya, from recycled acrylic yarn. Founded in 2019 by Leah Maina, it supports more than 25 women crocheters. It sells soft-toy animals (lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, hippos, rabbits and more), custom animals, gift sets and wholesale orders, with delivery across Kenya.

Contact: +254 724 592 115 (phone and WhatsApp) · mikonocreations@gmail.com · Instagram @mikonocreations

## Shop and order

- [Shop](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/shop): the full range of crocheted animals, priced in KES.
- [Gifts](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/gifts): gift sets and ideas.
- [Build a family](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/build-a-family): put together a matching set of animals.
- [Custom orders](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/custom): design your own animal or colours.
- [Wholesale](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/wholesale): bulk and retail-partner orders.
- [Size guide](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/size-guide) and [size finder](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/size-finder)
- [Delivery](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/delivery) and [returns](https://mikonocreations.co.ke/returns)
